channel.title: Office Noun

item.title: Agent bench, study 1: who picks up the work
item.description: A person posts work on a public board and walks away. Two and a half minutes to a pull request, a 14 second gym drill, and a cost guess ten times too low. Filed as a University of El Segundo study.

item.title: Surf Shop, the square cut
item.description: Twenty artifacts found in a surf shop that is also an office. Each Noun brought a board. The office desk's own drawing; the minted set is on objkt.
